claims.explanation: Deforolimus is an allosteric mTORC1 inhibitor, so sensitivity is expected in tumors whose growth depends on mTORC1-driven translation and survival signaling. The strongest genomic predictors are activation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis, especially PTEN loss and PIK3CA mutation, which are enriched in the most killed lines; EGFR-mutant lung lines also appear sensitive, consistent with upstream RTK-driven mTORC1 activation. Conversely, RAS/RAF-driven lines without PI3K-pathway lesions are often less affected, suggesting that MAPK-driven tumors may bypass mTORC1 dependence.
